# Hw1: Import data from statistical package and from Database management system

## Installation of packages open the files from statistical packages

install.packages(c("haven","readxl","readr"))

## Load the packages

library(haven)
library(readxl)
library(readr)

## Load the data # Excel format

excel_data <-read_excel("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/student_marks.xlsx")

## summarizing the data 
head(excel_data)
tail(excel_data)
summary(excel_data$science)

## Load the data # CSV format

csv_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/student_marks.csv",show_col_types=FALSE)

## Summarize the data
head(csv_data)
tail(csv_data)
summary(csv_data$science)

## Load the data # Stata format

dta_data <- read_dta("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/student_marks.dta")

## Summarize the data
head(dta_data)
tail(dta_data)
summary(dta_data$science)

# Hw2: Class activities practice

## Vector: The foundational R data strucure

# Example 1

age<-c(25,20,16)
summary(age)

# Example 2
age <-c(35,24,15,27)
mean(age)

## Character

x <- c("a","b","c")
class<-c("M","F","F","M")

## Logical
x <-c(TRUE,FALSE)
x <-c(T,F)

## Complex
x<-c (1+0i,2+4i)

## Integer
x <- 9:29

## Matrix and operation with in matrices
(x<-matrix(1:6,nrow=2,ncol=3))

(y<-matrix(1:6,nrow=3,ncol=2))
x%*%y
